title: AnyLogic workflows and connector status
description: Explore AnyLogic workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

AnyLogic

AnyLogic

AnyLogic supports multimethod simulation using discrete-event, agent-based and system-dynamics models.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Map a dynamic system

Start from the selected part, stock, machine or cell layout. In the intended AnyLogic preview, map a dynamic system; the visible result is a process setup with work coordinates, resources and target geometry visible. Review orientation, reach, tooling and fixture assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Run scenario experiments

Begin with the chosen operations, tools or robot tasks. In the intended AnyLogic preview, run scenario experiments; the visible result is a generated path or production sequence over the same setup. Review clearance, collisions, limits, feeds and operation order before accepting or exporting it.

Compare policy outcomes

Use the simulated material removal, robot motion or process results. In the intended AnyLogic preview, compare policy outcomes; the visible result is a verification view with remaining stock, reach or cycle data exposed. Review collisions, code target, cycle time and safe human approval before accepting or exporting it.
